description: The APOLLO-Live team publishes the underlying data for the decision-support use cases in its software article, together with a template for asynchronous analyses. National Technical University of Athens, HOLISTIC and University of Jaen researchers provide two JSON files and an Excel workbook through Zenodo, free under CC BY 4.0. The collection supports reproduction of multi-criteria group-decision examples in energy and climate policy. It is a set of elicited preferences and configured examples, not observed operating data from an electricity network. The repository does not establish a uniform geographic or temporal coverage for all use cases. The files can supply decision weights or alternatives in policy and behavioural simulation experiments when their original context is retained. No directly related catalogue record was identified.
